items.headline: Rams' McVay unsure about Nacua's status for Week 3 vs. Broncos
items.description: Sean McVay said he doesn't know wide receiver Puka Nacua's game status for Week 3 against the Broncos, but the Rams' head coach said he's hopeful Nacua will play.
